findings: Independently read pre-IPO section (pp132-145) and all 11 directors' bios (pp214-222). Three NEDs are explicitly linked by employment to identified pre-IPO investors' managers: Lin Jian (Oriental Fortune Capital, parent of OFC Wuhu/OFC VC Investment which manage OFC Bohui Fund and OFC Jiaozi Fund), Gu Qin (Shanghai Tongrui, same Chinese name 上海通銳投資管理有限公司 at pdf p237 and p221, executive partner/manager of Huzhou Youxing, Suzhou Lianrui, Huzhou Youcheng, Suzhou Youxin), Xue Di (Shanghai Hehong Jinghui, executive partner of Qingdao Hongyi, Series C investor; same Chinese name on p143 and p221). A fourth NED Chen Kan is a partner at Qiming Venture Partners (QM282 group, Series B2/C investor) - a brand-level link only, not relied on. Candidate quotes verified verbatim, correct printed-page mapping; candidate interpretation follows the standard. Rights (p141) include veto over board matters but no explicit director-appointment right; the approval rests on seated officers of investors' managers, not on a right.
residual_uncertainty: Nomination is not stated verbatim; the link is by employment of the NED with the investor or its GP/manager. Gu Qin's employer Shanghai Tongrui is also a substantial shareholder/connected person, so her seat may partly reflect that, but Shanghai Tongrui is itself the manager of Pre-IPO Investors, so the value is unaffected. Chen Kan's link (Qiming Venture Partners) not needed for the conclusion.
